artworks.title: Old Virginny
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Kate Bunner, wife of the artist, 1902)
artworks.description: There are two pencil sketches on a vertically oriented paper. The top sketch shows a side view of a house made from timber with two stone chimneys and a wooden fence. Shrubs are visible beside the house. The bottom sketch shows a log cabin with a stone chimney and a rough-hewn timber roof. Both sketches are detailed and monochrome, composed of various shades of grey.

artworks.title: Ducks
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Kate Bunner, wife of the artist, 1902)

artworks.title: Robert Macaire Md de Bibles
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an image showing three figures in a room. One figure is standing and gesturing dramatically, while the other two figures are seated at a table with books on it. The table also has a bottle, a drink item, and dinnerware on it. There are piles of books around the room, one of which is labeled with the words "SAINT" and "BIBLE." The artwork uses caricature elements with expressive facial features and body language.

artworks.title: Au fait, maitre Barbotteau...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a courtroom scene with three individuals captured from the waist up. The man in the foreground appears to be a lawyer gesturing with both hands. He has a middle-aged appearance with curly, receding hair and a sharp nose. He wears a dark robe over a collared shirt. Behind him, a judge is seated, wearing a tall hat and formal attire, looking down at papers on the bench. In the foreground to the right, a woman is reclined, with her head tilted back, eyes closed, and mouth slightly open, wearing a headscarf. On the surface in front of them lies a stack of papers and a round inkpot. The background suggests a courtroom setting, as indicated by the bench and formal dress. The scene is captured in a drawn, monochromatic style.

artworks.title: Que Diable Monsieur Ne Bougez donc pas...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men from the waist up. The man on the left is seated, facing a canvas with his left hand holding a long stick pointing at the canvas. He has a pronounced nose, an open mouth, and short swept back hair, wearing a floral-patterned robe. The man on the right is seated with his arms folded, slightly turned towards the left. He has a rounded face with drooping eyelids and slicked back hair, wearing a high-collared white shirt under a dark coat. The background is plain, and the focus is on the interaction between the men and the canvas on an easel, with the man's reflection subtly visible in the canvas.

artworks.title: Garçon brasseur...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man walking in motion. He has distinct facial features and short hair. The man is wearing layered clothing, stockings, and flat shoes, and holding objects in his right hand. In the background are sketches of figures and a dog walking beside him.

artworks.title: Le Vieux Pécheur
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two men fishing. The scene shows the men from their heads to their waists, standing in water up to their waists. The man in the foreground is in a side profile, facing the right side of the image. He has a long nose, a prominent chin, and short hair, partially covered by a brimmed hat. His facial features are caricatured with an exaggerated profile. He is wearing a dark jacket and holding a basket across his chest. In his hand, he holds a fishing rod that extends out of the image's right edge. The background features another man, slightly blurred and seated, wearing a tall hat and fishing as well. Behind the men, there are indistinct vertical structures suggesting a waterfront fence or railing. The overall setting is outdoors, possibly by a city's waterway, depicted with line shading, giving it a rainy or overcast atmosphere.

artworks.title: Vous sentez bien, mon cher monsieur...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of two men from the waist up, closely facing each other. The man on the left is partially turned to the side, with his face in profile view. He has a prominent nose and tightly drawn lips, with a receding hairline and short, slicked-back hair. The man on the right faces the first man directly and is also seen from the waist up. He has exaggerated features with a strong nose, large ears, and curly dark hair. Both men's hands are visible, holding onto each other. The background is a neutral, textured area with lines and patterns. The text "INFIRMITÉS HUMAINES, No 1" is displayed at the top of the image, with printed French text below.

artworks.title: Garçon, qu'est-ce que c'est que ça?...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from the waist up engaged in an interaction. On the left, a person is leaning forward aggressively, holding a plate, with their upper body angled towards the other person. They have tightly pulled back hair into two buns with facial features marked by a pronounced frown and furrowed eyebrows. This person is dressed in a dark garment with a high neckline. The person on the right is seated, also shown from the waist up, with his body turned slightly away from the other person, extending an arm to present a small item held between the thumb and forefinger. He has short, wavy hair and a distressed expression. His attire includes a light-colored vest under a darker coat and a patterned cravat tied at the neck. In front of him on the table, there is a clear bottle and a small glass. The background is plain and appears to have vertical linear patterns.

artworks.title: Vous savez bien l'éponge que vous disiez...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The illustration shows two men engaged in conversation. The man on the left is in profile, facing right, with crossed arms and a bemused expression. He has a prominent nose and is wearing a pointed hat with a tassel and a collared shirt. The man on the right is also in profile, facing the first man, with a slightly open mouth. He is wearing a round chef's hat and a collared shirt. In the background, there are drawings of kitchen utensils hanging on the wall.

artworks.title: Oui, chère amie, jaloux tant que tu voudras!...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a room. One person is lying in bed, partially covered by a blanket with their head resting on their hand. They wear a nightcap and are illuminated by a candle on a nearby table. The second person, standing beside the bed, is dressed in a military-style uniform with a hat, jacket, and trousers. They have distinct facial features, including a long nose. The background features floral wallpaper, fabric drapes around the bed, and an intimate atmosphere.

artworks.title: Mariez-vous donc! vieux Grigou...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing beside a bed with a man lying in it. The woman is wearing a cap and a long garment, while the man is wearing a nightcap and lying on a pillow. Surrounding the bed are a rug, a side table with a candlestick, and French text above and below the scene.

artworks.title: Ciel!...je trouve ma femme déménagée!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in front of a partially open doorway. He is leaning slightly forward with one hand outstretched. The man has a surprised expression with his mouth open and eyes wide. He is wearing a top hat, long cloak, striped pants, and pointed shoes. In the background, there is a door partly open, revealing a barren room with a fallen chair. The surface has thin vertical lines suggesting wooden paneling or wallpaper.

artworks.title: Hein! comme il regarde les cervelas...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three exaggerated caricatures at a table with slices of meat in front of them. Exaggerated sausages hang above their heads. The composition features distorted facial features and enlarged hands. The expressions convey a mix of anticipation and absurdity. The background is sketched with informal lines, depicting a domestic setting. The drawing presents a satirical commentary on domestic life or consumption.

artworks.title: Visite matinale d'un créancier
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of two men in a bedroom setting. The man on the left is standing beside the bed, dressed in a long coat, trousers, tall boots, and a top hat. He is holding boots or shoes. The seated man on the bed is shown from the waist up, leaning on his elbow with a distressed expression. He is wearing a nightcap and a long nightshirt. A patterned carpet and a pair of boots or shoes are visible on the floor. The background features a sparsely detailed patterned wallpaper.

artworks.title: Quelle heure est'il, s'il vous plait?...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration featuring two men. The man on the left is in a bent, forward-leaning position with his body angled sharply towards the man on the right, who stands facing forward with his hands in his coat pockets. The man on the left has exaggerated facial features, including a long nose and a pointed chin, with distinctive high cheekbones, and his hair is hidden by a tall hat. He is dressed in a worn-out coat and striped trousers, holding a long stick or cane. The man on the right has more subtle facial features, with a round face and minimal visible hair under his tall hat. He wears a dark, long coat, dark trousers, and slip-on shoes, looking surprised as he looks at the man on the left. The setting appears to be a cobblestone street with tall buildings in the background, suggesting an urban environment. The illustration has a textured, grainy style, adding a sense of depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Saisissement
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing between two large wheels of a cart loaded with wooden logs. The person appears to be bracing or in motion, with legs spread and bent at the knees. They have arms outstretched in front and a wide-open mouth. The person has short, dark, slightly disheveled hair and is wearing a dark suit jacket, light-colored shirt, dark pants with vertical stripes, and boots. The background features sketch buildings in an urban setting.

artworks.title: Ma fois je ne sais pas comment ils ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: In this image, a man in formal attire is looking at himself in a tall mirror. He is holding a sword and wearing glasses, an elaborate hat, a military uniform with a high collar, epaulets, a sash, tight pants, and boots. He also has a scabbard and a satchel. The background is simple with faint text above the man that reads "Coquetterie."

artworks.title: Ascension de Jèsus-Christ
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of clouds with feet emerging from the top of an arched frame and arrows pointing upwards from below. The composition shows a pair of feet and the hem of a garment at the top. The central part of the image is filled with voluminous clouds depicted in shades of grey. At the bottom of the arch, four arrows are pointed upwards. The artwork is presented in an arched format.

artworks.title: A bon chat bon rat
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two individuals engaged in a dynamic fight. The person on the left appears to be attacking, with their body leaning forward and their arm extended, while the person on the right is bent backward. Both individuals have exaggerated expressions and dramatic hair movement. They are wearing long, loose-fitting garments. The background is minimal, with a plain surface. There is a border around the sketch, with text above and below indicating it is part of a series titled "Proverbes et Maximes" and the caption "A bon chat, bon rat."

artworks.title: On reprend son bien ou on le trouve
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in period attire engaged in a struggle. The foreground features a figure grabbing another by the lapels of his coat. Both are dressed in early 19th-century style, with tall top hats and tailored coats. The setting suggests a street or urban environment, with faint outlines of buildings in the background and a distant figure walking away. The artwork uses black and white shading to create texture and depth. There is an inscription at the bottom written in French, "On reprend son bien où on le trouve."

artworks.title: C'est pesque toujours a la halle ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals interacting at a market stall. One person, an elderly individual with a hooded cloak, sits behind the stall. The other person, wearing a hat and cloak, is standing and leaning towards the stall, handing over an object. An empty purse is in their hand. Both have aged facial features. The stall displays fish for sale, with containers and bags nearby. In the background, another figure carries a large sack on their back, and there are indistinct buildings, suggesting an older European town market scene.

artworks.title: Le marchand de contremarques
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures interacting in a street. The drawing depicts a scene where two individuals, both wearing formal attire including top hats, are engaged in an interaction in front of a theater ticket booth. The central figure on the right, appearing older with a hunched posture, is presenting a slip of paper. The individual on the left listens attentively. Behind them, another figure is waiting in line. The background includes a wall poster advertising a play or performance. The drawing features fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: L'ami d'un grand homme
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a room. One person is lying in a bed with a blanket covering them up to their chest, their head on a pillow. The other person stands next to the bed with hands clasped in front. The setting includes a nightstand with a lit candle and a wall with patterned drapery.
